title: Define platform outbound routing state and message binding boundaries
description: AstrBot rich platform adapters cache session scene, last inbound/outbound message IDs, sender bindings, and platform-specific reply routing state. Rust should define a common outbound routing state boundary before QQ Official, DingTalk, Lark, WeCom, and proactive-send parity grow adapter internals.

files.change: Define session scene, last message ID, reply target, sender binding, and proactive-send route selection types.
Persist adapter routing bindings behind storage ports where platform APIs require historical message IDs.

criteria: Adapters consume routing bindings through common typed state.
Proactive sends do not require each adapter to invent its own untyped session cache.
Binding storage can be tested without network platform clients.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
